Under the new leadership at NEXTDC, I encountered several challenges that significantly impacted my experience. The lack of support and communication within the team made it difficult to thrive. Additionally, there seemed to be a preference for power plays rather than nurturing a collaborative environment, which I found to be counterproductive. One of the most frustrating aspects was the apparent lack of knowledge and expertise within the management team compared to my own experience. I often felt that I had a deeper understanding of certain aspects of the job. Despite my willingness to contribute and share my knowledge, this was not always valued or acknowledged. While the leaders did communicate a vision, the day-to-day realities within the company, such as the lack of support, communication breakdowns, and power dynamics, overshadowed the positive aspects of that vision. These factors played a significant role in my decision to leave NEXTDC. While I encountered challenges during my time here, I also recognize that every organization has room for improvement. Firstly, I would encourage NEXTDC to consider enhancing communication and transparency within the company. Clearer communication channels and a more transparent decision-making process can help employees understand the company's direction and feel more engaged Secondly, I would suggest exploring ways to foster a more inclusive and diverse workplace. This could involve initiatives to ensure that all employees, regardless of their roles or schedules, feel valued and included. Lastly, I would recommend evaluating opportunities for professional growth and career advancement within the organization. A structured approach to career development and mentorship programs can go long way in retaining and nurturing talent.
